tagline: Surf, chill and feel at home in Ahangama

copyBlocks.heading: Five minutes from Kabalana Beach
copyBlocks.body:
A family runs this place, and they set out to make you feel at home from the moment you arrive. Kabalana Beach is a five-minute walk.

Dorms if you want the company, private rooms if you don't.

copyBlocks.heading: What guests say about the staff
copyBlocks.body:
"Family" is the word guests keep using. One of them caught dengue in Kandy and wrote that the staff helped nurse her back to health with Ayurvedic medicines, on top of what the hospital was already giving her.

On Booking.com the staff get 9.9 out of 10, the hostel's highest score there. Hostelworld guests give them the same 9.9, and only value for money and security do better, both at a full 10.

copyBlocks.heading: Breakfast, every day
copyBlocks.body: Rotis, fruit, pancakes and eggs, with vegan options.

copyBlocks.heading: Dorms and private rooms
copyBlocks.body:
Mixed, female and male dormitories with bunk beds, plus double rooms and deluxe doubles. Every room has air conditioning and a fan, private lockers and a personal fridge. The bathrooms are modern and the showers are hot.

Rates change with the dates — the booking links below show what is actually free.

copyBlocks.heading: What is here
copyBlocks.body:
A green garden and a chill zone. Free filtered water you can refill any time. Laundry. A minimarket on site. Scooter rental, with a surf rack available. Luggage storage, lockers, and a 24-hour reception.

Pets are welcome on request at no charge. Children are not accommodated.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here
copyBlocks.body: Ahangama, a five-minute walk from Kabalana Beach. Koggala Airport is about 5 km away; Ahangama railway station is a little over 2 km. The property arranges a shuttle.

spot: Kabalana: a sandy beach break for beginners and intermediates, and The Rock, a reef A-frame for advanced surfers.

stayInfo.note: Reception is open 24 hours. Children are not accommodated, and cots and extra beds are not available.

amenities.label: Air conditioning and a fan in every room
Private locker and personal fridge in every room

testimonials.quote: Lovely location away from the main road. So close to the beach! The most amazing family who look after you like you're one of their own. Thank you KA!
testimonials.author: Clara, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: Great family owned hostel :-) they are really friendly and helpful! The breakfast always consists of a typical Sri Lankan dish (roti, hoppers,…) which changes every day and additionally a great fruit platter!! Dorms are big, bathrooms are nice with the whole outdoor thing :-)
testimonials.author: Elena, Germany

testimonials.quote: I got dengue in Kandy and the staff at KA helped nurse me back to health with Ayurvedic medicines (on top of what the hospital was already giving me) They are the kindest people and they attract good vibes. I met some of the best people here :)
testimonials.author: Mia, USA

testimonials.quote: It's a calm and quiet place, a wonderful staff, caring owners and clean. I had a really good time even i havnt spent much time there. beds are compfy and it has aircon and warm water.
testimonials.author: Wolfgang, Austria

testimonials.quote: Owners very hospitable, breakfast in the morning was great, close to kabalana beach so great for surfing
testimonials.author: Saketh, England
